notes: Coverage status of tests the frozen formal text sets for itself. Each item below is quoted from the frozen chapter; the state recorded against it is a statement about what the research panels carry, not a new fact about any company. No item here is promoted into a chapter and the formal reopen gate is unchanged: this layer records status, never conclusions.

states.carried: the research panels carry an observation for this variable, with a named facility or support form behind it
states.partly observable: half of the variable is carried and the other half is not disclosed, so the quantity the chapter names cannot be formed even though its inputs partly exist
states.not disclosed: no disclosure supplies this variable and none is expected from the ordinary reporting the panels track
states.not yet observed: the variable is an outcome rather than a state: no observation of it can exist before the event it describes occurs

register_note: The frozen corpus was searched in both editions for enumerated evidence-requirement checklists of the form 'a defensible X would require evidence on: [list]'. Ch23 §1B is the only one found; a search of the English edition for 'would require evidence on / would need evidence / requires evidence of' and of the Chinese edition for the corresponding 需要证据 / 需要看到 forms returns this checklist and one non-enumerated rule at Ch21. The register therefore has one entry, and it is stated as such rather than presented as a survey. If a later reading finds a second enumerated checklist, it is added here as another gate and the layer's §0 scope is unchanged.

gates.test: whether the current AI buildout can be classified as a replay of the telecom bubble or the 2008 securitization cycle
gates.rule: Without those contract-level variables, the analogy remains a research heuristic, not a formal report conclusion.
gates.rule_zh: 如果这些 contract-level 变量没有公开，历史类比只能作为研究启发（research heuristic），不能升级成正式结论。

items.detail: Debt principal, coupon, maturity, collateral and non-recourse status are carried per facility. The asset-side valuation that an LTV needs is not disclosed by any facility in the panel, so the ratio itself cannot be formed from the disclosures tracked here.

A DSCR covenant of 1.15x plus a minimum-liquidity covenant (Nebius), disclosed DDTL covenant compliance (CoreWeave), and recourse recorded as such — DDTL 4.0 is largely non-recourse and several facilities sit in SPVs.

Carried as a distinct support form rather than as a footnote to revenue: take-or-pay colocation structures and customer prepayment / minimum payment, with the contracted cash flow identified as what supports debtability.

Guarantee caps are carried with residual value named as a tracked field: NVIDIA LPS guarantees at about US$3.529B notional, the SB Energy PORTS-Pike aggregate obligation capped at US$105B, AMD partner lease guarantees at about US$4.1B, and Applied Digital project completion guarantees.
Instrument seniority is recorded — senior secured notes, senior secured facilities, convertibles. The loss waterfall between tranches, which is what 'loss allocation' means, is not disclosed.

Drawn state, pricing, covenant and rollover are refreshed, and two refinancing actions are observed rather than assumed: Core Scientific's March-2026 term loan repaid and replaced by the 2031 notes, and Applied Digital's bridge refinanced into the 2031 notes after year-end.

No borrower in the panel has defaulted or restructured, so this variable has no observations at all rather than a missing one. No disclosure can supply it before the event it describes, which makes this a permanent floor on the Ch23 §1B test rather than a gap that further reporting closes.

items.item: transferability and secondary-market liquidity of the underlying assets
items.detail: No secondary market for GPU or data-center assets exists at observable liquidity. 11 §6 lists successful asset transfer between customers or operators as a falsification signal — i.e. something to watch for, not something measured. The adjacent market-structure item, the compute futures announced for 2026-10-05 (still PRE-LAUNCH as of 2026-10-26: announced date missed; CFTC Approval Pending, review through 2026-11-09; RFC closed; non-tradable index curve data ≠ futures launch), is likewise pending liquidity rather than carrying any.
